item.title: Hirosaka Castle Ruins: A Quiet Hilltop in Izumo — Guide
item.description: Hirosaka Castle is a ruined mountain castle in the Izumo area, the kind of quiet historical site that rewards travellers who prefer atmosphere and imagination to reconstructed keeps. Little remains above ground beyond earthworks, terraced platforms and traces of stone, worn by centuries and half-reclaimed by trees, but the outline of the old fortifications can still be read across the hilltop, and the climb is rewarded with a view over the Izumo plain.
